_readme: Reusable config pack for home-monitor. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
targets[].name is the handle you pass to tools as { target: 'name' }.
http.targets[].expect accepts a number or an array of acceptable status codes.
ssl.targets[].warnDays overrides the global ssl.warnDays for one host.
docker.enabled=false is the safe default: it reports 'unavailable' instead of failing.
Hosts are masked as ***.***.*.*** - replace them with your own box's LAN address.
